memories.text: Release notes for the team are published on the first Monday of each month.
The team's retrospective is held every other Thursday at 10:00 in the Lisbon office.
The on-call rotation for the platform team changes every Wednesday at noon.

In this project, every error returned to API clients carries a code of the form ERR-PAY-<4 digits>. A code names one failure reason and is never reused; a new failure reason takes the next free number.
In this project, a new error code is registered in both places with the same value: a row in docs/error-codes.md and a constant in internal/apperr/codes.go.

In this project, code under internal/ logs only through internal/xlog, using a logger from xlog.For("<component>") where the component is the lowercase name of the handler group, such as payments or customers. The stdlib log and slog packages and fmt.Print calls are rejected in review.
In this project, a log line for a rejected request carries the response's error code under the key code, for example code=ERR-PAY-0004. Reviewers reject rejection logs that lack it.
In this project, every exported handler of internal/api is listed with its method and path in internal/api/routes_manifest.go. A new handler missing from that manifest is rejected in review.
